title: Don’t Attempt USMLE Step 1 Without Knowing This Revision Strategy
description:
Aasritha recently took the USMLE Step 1 exam and shares what helped during her final preparation.

From high-yield integrated revision and clinical images to simulation practice, she explains why starting case-based revision early can make a big difference.

Her suggestion: go through your high-yield cases early, revise them more than once, and use your final week for one last review.
